title: edf-buffered-write: reproducibility package for 'Silent corruption of EDF recordings during real-time biopotential streaming: a buffered-write solution'
description: Code, scripts and data needed to reproduce all figures and numerical results of the manuscript (under review). It characterises a silent data-corruption failure that arises when real-time acquisition software writes sub-record blocks to an EDF file with incremental writers such as pyedflib, quantifies it across sampling rates, record durations, block sizes and channel counts, compares three independent EDF-writing implementations (pyedflib, EDFlib-Python, edfio), reproduces it on a real surface-EMG recording, and provides a buffered-write pattern and a round-trip integrity test that remove and detect it.
